sentences.en: Three days before the parolee is actually released, he is transferred into the light security wing to undergo a complete physical and a battery of vocational tests.

sentences.en: Some police agencies lock anklets on criminal suspects, convicts and parolees that set off an alarm if the person leaves home.

sentences.en: Parole revocation is one of the punishments on a parolee who fails to abide by the conditions of parole.
